answer: The pulse counter is kept in dawn and velvet shows each reset. Someone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 27 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 27 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1791 identities would post 540 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
